Source: BodyParts3D 4.0, isa_BP3D_4.0_obj_99.zip. All 2,234 source mesh IDs preserved.
Optimised data distribution: https://github.com/ashemag/human-atlas/tree/main/public/models
Prior adaptations: axis/unit conversion, mesh simplification, normal quantisation and binary packing.
Jiki adaptations: local hosting, group colours, visibility/opacity controls, per-part selection, separated viewing, search and study exercises. No meshes removed.
An adult male reference; not an exhaustive representation of all human anatomy or variation.
